caption:
The $20,000 instant asset write-off just went permanent.

From 1 July 2026 it's locked in — not a one-year extension, not "maybe next budget". Permanent.

Buy a business asset under $20,000, install or use it this year, and claim it in full. No depreciation schedule. No waiting.

Who qualifies: aggregated turnover under $10 million. New or second-hand assets. Business-use portion only — if it's part personal, split it.

The one catch that matters: the asset must be first used or installed ready for use in the year you claim it. Bought it and left it in the box? Doesn't count.

Save this for your next equipment purchase.
